description: rules check warns about a file of a secret that belongs to an account that is none of Atoll's, root's, the one that runs it or the catalog's, as that account may change it whatever its mode; the configuration loads all the same. Given back to root, it gets no warning. Another group that may read it is not told of.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[notify.jellyfin]
url = "https://jellyfin.example.com"
api_key_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/jellyfin.key"
[alerts]
ntfy = "https://ntfy.example.com/atoll"
ntfy_token_file = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1/secrets/ntfy.token"
